bite_attack.description: Melee chomp. Uses the part's damage hitboxes during the active phase; hitboxes lunge with a 12deg head-bone dip.

sting_attack.description: Fast forward poke from the tail bone; longest reach in v1, good for switches behind grates.

club_attack.description: Slow heavy swing, big knockback. Tail bone sweeps 90deg during active phase.

can_glide.description: While airborne, falling, and jump_glide HELD: vertical speed clamped to glide_fall_cap; air control multiplied by glide_air_control. Releasing resumes normal gravity.

double_jump.description: One extra jump per airtime on jump_glide TAP while airborne; resets on landing or wall grab. If the creature also has can_glide, tap = double jump, hold = glide.

can_climb.description: While overlapping a 'climbable' layer wall and holding climb_up: ascend at climb_speed; gravity off; drains nothing (v1). Jump from wall gives a small away-impulse.

dodge_roll.description: crouch_roll on ground: fixed-distance roll with i-frames. Fits under crawl tunnels only while rolling.

crouch.description: crouch_roll HELD on ground: half-height hurtbox, move at crouch_speed, fits crawl tunnels continuously.

jump_boost.description: Multiplies the weight-class jump_velocity by the part's stats.jump_mod (declared on the part; this effect just flags the mechanic for UI icons). Legal in any slot: it is a UI flag for a stat multiplier, not a slot mechanic (D1).

speed_boost.description: Multiplies weight-class max_speed by the part's stats.speed_mod. UI icon flag; math applied by WeightClass. Legal in any slot: it is a UI flag for a stat multiplier, not a slot mechanic (D1).

air_dash.description: jump_glide TAP while airborne and already out of jumps, or crouch_roll in the air: one committed horizontal burst of air_dash.distance over air_dash.duration, with gravity suspended. One per airtime; resets on landing or on a wall cling.

wall_cling.description: While overlapping a 'climbable' wall and pressing into it: stick to the face and slide down at wall_cling.slide_speed instead of falling. Resets double_jump and air_dash. Without can_climb you cannot ascend, only hold.

thick_hide.description: Knockback taken is multiplied by thick_hide.knockback_mult on top of the weight class' own knockback_taken_mult. Stacks multiplicatively across parts, so a fully armoured build barely moves when hit.

heavy_landing.description: Breaks 'world_cracked' floors on landing regardless of weight class, at the same crack_break_min_land_speed the Heavy class uses. Lets a light build buy its way through a Heavy-only floor (DESIGN §9 lock and key).

ink_magnet.description: Multiplies economy.ink_pickup_magnet_radius by ink_magnet.radius_mult, so ink drifts to the creature instead of being walked over. Stacks multiplicatively.

quick_strike.description: Multiplies an attack's windup, recovery and cooldown by quick_strike.time_mult. The active window is untouched, so the attack comes out sooner without becoming easier to land.

long_reach.description: Scales every equipped damage box by long_reach.size_mult, about its own offset, so attacks land from further out without moving where they point.

spit_attack.description: Ranged. Instead of arming a damage box, the active phase launches one projectile from the part's damage box, travelling at combat.spit.speed for combat.spit.lifetime seconds or until it hits world or a hurtbox. Carries the part's attack_power, knockback and hitstun.

notes: slot_kinds documents where the effect is legal; the boot validator enforces it.
Attack effects require the part to carry an 'attack' block (windup/active/recovery/cooldown/knockback/hitstun).
Env hazards bypass the attack-window rule (layer 'hazard'); creature damage never does.
